title_sq: Shitet, Apartament 1+1, Don Bosko – Ngjitur me Kompleksin Fiori Di Bosko , 128,000 Euro
description_sq:

– Apartament 1+1

– Kati 3

Shitet apartament 1+1 me siperfaqe 59.45m², i cili ndodhet ne katin e 3 te nje pallati te ri,ne Don Bsoko, ngjitur me Kompleksin Fiori Di Bosko. Apartamenti eshte totalisht i invstuar edhe i shtruar me parket. Hyrja organizohet ne sallon ndenje te bollshem ku ka dhe nje dritare te madhe qe lejon ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites, ambienti i gatimi, 1 dhomë gjumi e madhe e cila ka dhe dalje ne ballkon dhe tualeti. Apartamenti eshte totalisht i investuar, i shtruar me parket dhe gati per mobilim. Mundesi shume e mire investimi!!!
Disponon dokumetacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Ndodhet ne nje zonë të qetë e cila i ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme.
Per me shume informacione ose per nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjencise imobiliare.
title_en: For sale, Apartment 1+1, Don Bosko - Adjacent to Fiori Di Bosko Complex, 128,000 Euros
description_en: Property features: - 1+1 apartment - Don Bosco - New building with elevator completed in 2024 - 3rd floor - Gross area 59.45m² - Net area 50.75m² - Price 128,000 Euro 1+1 apartment for sale with an area of 59.45m², located on the 3rd floor of a new building, in Don Bsoko, adjacent to the Fiori Di Bosco Complex. The apartment is completely invested and laid with parquet. The entrance is organized in a spacious living room where there is a large window that allows natural light throughout the day, a kitchen area, 1 large bedroom with access to the balcony and a toilet. The apartment is fully invested, laid with parquet and ready for furnishing. Very good investment opportunity!!! Has regular mortgage documentation. It is located in a quiet area that offers all the necessary facilities. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact the number of the real estate agency.
